title: Συναισθήματα και σχέσεις
description: Ten standalone stories about feelings and the ties between people: family, couples, friends and neighbours in Greece today.

lessons.title: Η γραφομηχανή της προγιαγιάς
lessons.summary: A girl spends two summer weeks with her great-grandmother in Nafplio, who is typing her memoirs on an old typewriter.

lessons.title: Το καινούργιο φούτερ
lessons.summary: A fifteen-year-old with a pimple wants to skip a class party, and his "boring" father quietly helps him go with his old friend.

lessons.title: Το σπίτι που περίμενε
lessons.summary: A couple from Athens keep an old promise and spend their first winter in an empty family house in an Epirus village.

lessons.title: Η μεγάλη αδελφή
lessons.summary: After a fall, a woman spends two days in hospital for tests, and her older sister helps her through the fear.

lessons.title: Τρεις πια
lessons.summary: After years of waiting, a couple's daughter is born on New Year's Eve, and the new father learns that love does not need superhuman strength.

lessons.title: Το ατελιέ της Κυψέλης
lessons.summary: Two friends who share a ceramics studio fall out over whose idea a new design was, and make peace by talking it through.

lessons.title: Ο παππούς ο αντιστράτηγος
lessons.summary: A teenager sails with her strict grandfather, a retired general, to visit his brother the monk, and sees a softer side of him.

lessons.title: Η πρώτη μακαρονάδα
lessons.summary: A man cooks dinner for his partner's two children for the first time and wins over the youngest, who hates peas.

lessons.title: Ο πατέρας μου, ο έμπορος
lessons.summary: A daughter buys her first house with a loan, and her father, an old fabric merchant, inspects it and bargains for her as he has done all his life.

lessons.title: Οι δύο βαλέδες
lessons.summary: Two old friends who met hitchhiking fifty years ago meet for cards every Thursday in a Chania café and argue about everything.
